title: Make a Joyful Noise to the Lord

questions.question: Oh sing to the Lord a new song, for he has done what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 98:1 (ESV): "Oh sing to the Lord a new song, for he has done marvelous things!"

questions.question: His right hand and his holy arm have worked what for him?
questions.explanation: Psalm 98:1 (ESV): "His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him."

questions.question: The Lord has made known his salvation; he has revealed his righteousness in the sight of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 98:2 (ESV): "...he has revealed his righteousness in the sight of the nations."

questions.question: He has remembered his steadfast love and faithfulness to the house of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 98:3 (ESV): "He has remembered his steadfast love and faithfulness to the house of Israel."

questions.question: All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 98:3 (ESV): "All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God."

questions.question: Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth; break forth into what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 98:4 (ESV): "...break forth into joyous song and sing praises!"

questions.question: Sing praises to the Lord with the lyre, with the lyre and the sound of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 98:5 (ESV): "...with the lyre and the sound of melody!"

questions.question: With trumpets and the sound of the horn make a joyful noise before the King, the who?
questions.explanation: Psalm 98:6 (ESV): "...make a joyful noise before the King, the Lord!"

questions.question: Let the sea roar, and all that fills it; the world and those who dwell in where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 98:7 (ESV): "...the world and those who dwell in it!"

questions.question: Let the rivers clap their hands; let the hills sing for joy together before whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 98:8-9 (ESV): "...let the hills sing for joy together before the Lord,"

questions.question: For he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with what?
What instruments are mentioned in Psalm 98?
What has the Lord done according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalm 98:1 (ESV): "...for he has done marvelous things!"

questions.question: What do the rivers do in verse 8?
questions.explanation: Psalm 98:8 (ESV): "Let the rivers clap their hands;"

questions.question: Before whom should we make a joyful noise with trumpets?
questions.explanation: Psalm 98:6 (ESV): "...make a joyful noise before the King, the Lord!"

key_verse_text: Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth; break forth into joyous song and sing praises!
